# Artifact Panel

## Summary
A side panel that opens beside the chat to hold a substantial thing the model made — a document, a component, a diagram — so it can be read, versioned, copied and revised without scrolling the transcript. The message that produced it keeps a compact card that opens the panel; follow-up turns write new versions into the same panel instead of pasting the whole thing again.

## When to use
- The output is something people will keep and reuse (a plan, a page of code, an HTML app, a diagram), not an answer to read once.
- The output is long enough that showing it inline would push the conversation off screen — roughly more than a screen of text or a dozen lines of code.
- People will iterate on it over several turns ("make it shorter", "add a pricing section") and need to compare versions.
- The output renders into something other than text (a live preview of a component, a chart), where a preview and its source are both useful.

## When not to use
- Short answers, snippets or a few lines of code — keep them inline. A panel for a three-line reply is a detour.
- Content the user is meant to read in the flow of the conversation (an explanation, a summary). Put it in the message.
- When the product already has a document or editor surface. Write into that surface directly instead of a second, parallel one.
- When the screen is too narrow for two columns and the artifact is not the main point — an inline expandable block costs less than covering the chat.

## Anatomy
- Artifact card: in the message that created the artifact — a type icon, the title, the type and version ("Document · v2") and an open affordance. One card per version-producing message, so the transcript shows where each version came from.
- Panel: beside the chat on wide screens, covering it on narrow ones.
- Header: the title, a one-line note on what this version changed, a version stepper ("v2/2"), Copy and Close.
- View tabs: Preview and Code, shown only when the artifact has source behind its rendering.
- Body: the rendered artifact or its source, scrolling on its own.
- Writing state: a thin indeterminate bar and a dimmed body while a new version is being written.

## Behavior
- The panel opens automatically when the model starts writing an artifact, and on demand from any card. Opening an older message's card shows that message's version.
- A follow-up that changes the artifact adds a new version and switches the panel to it. Earlier versions stay reachable from the stepper; nothing is overwritten.
- While a new version is written, the previous one stays visible but dimmed, so the user never looks at an empty panel. Don't let them edit a version that is being replaced.
- Side by side from about 42rem of container width; below that the panel covers the chat and Close returns to it. Size the split by the container, not the viewport, so the pattern also works inside a narrow pane.
- Escape and Close collapse the panel and return focus to the card that opened it. The chat column keeps its scroll position.
- Copy copies the current version's source, and confirms in place ("Copied") for a moment.

## Content guidelines
- Titles name the thing, not the request: "Q3 beta launch plan", not "Here's your plan".
- Version notes say what changed in a few words ("Shorter, one screen", "Added pricing"), not "Updated version".
- The message that carries the card says what the artifact is or what changed in a sentence. Don't repeat the artifact's content in the message.
- Type labels are concrete ("Document", "React", "HTML", "Diagram"), never "Artifact".

## Accessibility
- The card is a real button with `aria-expanded` reflecting whether its panel is open.
- The panel is a labelled `aside` (named by its title). On open, focus moves to the title; on close, it returns to the opening card.
- Preview and Code use the tabs pattern: `role="tablist"`, `aria-selected` on each tab, and a labelled `tabpanel`.
- The version label and the "Writing a new version…" note sit in polite live regions so version changes are announced; the body is `aria-busy` while writing.
- Icon-only buttons (previous, next, copy, close) carry accessible names. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: fade the panel in instead of sliding it.

## Related patterns
- **Code Preview Block** — Use it instead for a short snippet that should stay inline in the message.
- **Diff Tabs** — Use it as well when the artifact is code and people need to see what changed between versions.
- **Selection Actions** — Use it inside the panel so people can select a passage and ask for a change to just that part.
- **Conversation Branches** — Use it instead when people want alternative replies to one prompt, not successive versions of one thing.

## Default implementation (Tailwind v4 + Radix + Motion)

This is the catalogue's own reference implementation — use it verbatim when the
host project has no established design system, or when the user asks for
"the demoed look." When the host project has its own design system, treat
this code as a translation reference: keep every rule from the spec above
(Anatomy, Behavior, Content guidelines, Accessibility) and re-express the
markup, styling, and motion using that system's own components/tokens
instead of copying these Tailwind classes or the Motion API.

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { Check, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Code2, Copy, FileText, LayoutPanelLeft, X } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export interface ArtifactVersion {
  id: string;
  /** What changed in this version, e.g. "Shorter, one page". Shown under the title. */
  note?: string;
  /** The rendered artifact for the Preview tab. */
  preview: React.ReactNode;
  /** Source for the Code tab and for Copy. Omit to hide the tab. */
  source?: string;
}

export interface Artifact {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** A short type label: "Document", "React", "HTML", "Diagram"… */
  kind: string;
  versions: ArtifactVersion[];
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Inline card: the artifact's place in the transcript                 */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ArtifactCardProps {
  artifact: Artifact;
  /** Index of the version this message produced. */
  version?: number;
  open?: boolean;
  /** Still being written. The card stays clickable so people can watch it fill. */
  generating?: boolean;
  onOpen: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

export const ArtifactCard = React.forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ArtifactCardProps>(function ArtifactCard(
  { artifact, version = artifact.versions.length - 1, open, generating, onOpen, className },
  ref
) {
  const Icon = artifact.versions[version]?.source && artifact.kind !== "Document" ? Code2 : FileText;
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type="button"
      onClick={onOpen}
      aria-expanded={open}
      className={cn(
        "group flex w-full max-w-xs items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border bg-card p-2 pr-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-accent/60",
        open && "border-foreground/30 bg-accent/40",
        className
      )}
    >
      <span className="flex size-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
        <Icon className="size-4" aria-hidden />
      </span>
      <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        <span className="block truncate text-sm font-medium">{artifact.title}</span>
        <span className="block text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {generating ? "Writing…" : `${artifact.kind} · v${version + 1}`}
        </span>
      </span>
      <span className="shrink-0 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-foreground">
        {open ? "Open" : "View"}
      </span>
    </button>
  );
});

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* Split layout: chat beside the panel, or the panel over the chat     */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ArtifactSplitProps {
  open: boolean;
  chat: React.ReactNode;
  panel: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

/**
 * Side by side when the container is at least 42rem wide; below that the
 * panel covers the chat, because two cramped columns serve neither.
 */
export function ArtifactSplit({ open, chat, panel, className }: ArtifactSplitProps) {
  return (
    <div className={cn("@container relative flex h-full w-full overflow-hidden", className)}>
      <div className={cn("flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col", open && "@max-2xl:invisible")}>{chat}</div>
      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>{open && panel}</AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* The panel                                                           */
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ */

export interface ArtifactPanelProps {
  artifact: Artifact;
  version: number;
  onVersionChange: (index: number) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  /** The model is writing a new version right now. */
  generating?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

export function ArtifactPanel({
  artifact,
  version,
  onVersionChange,
  onClose,
  generating,
  className,
}: ArtifactPanelProps) {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const [tab, setTab] = React.useState<"preview" | "code">("preview");
  const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false);
  const headingRef = React.useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
  const id = React.useId();

  const current = artifact.versions[version];
  const count = artifact.versions.length;
  const hasSource = Boolean(current?.source);
  const activeTab = hasSource ? tab : "preview";

  // Move focus into the panel when it opens so keyboard and screen-reader
  // users land on the thing they asked to see. Whoever opened it gets focus
  // back on close (see the demo's card ref).
  React.useEffect(() => {
    headingRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (!copied) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [copied]);

  async function copy() {
    const text = current?.source ?? "";
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      setCopied(true);
    } catch {
      // Clipboard can be blocked (iframes, permissions); fail quietly.
    }
  }

  return (
    <motion.aside
      aria-labelledby={`${id}-title`}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        if (e.key === "Escape") {
          e.stopPropagation();
          onClose();
        }
      }}
      initial={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, x: 24 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
      exit={reduce ? { opacity: 0 } : { opacity: 0, x: 24 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: "easeOut" }}
      className={cn(
        "absolute inset-0 z-10 flex flex-col bg-background @2xl:static @2xl:w-[58%] @2xl:shrink-0 @2xl:border-l",
        className
      )}
    >
      <header className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b px-3 py-2">
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h3
            ref={headingRef}
            id={`${id}-title`}
            tabIndex={-1}
            className="truncate text-sm font-medium outline-none"
          >
            {artifact.title}
          </h3>
          <p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
            {generating ? "Writing a new version…" : current?.note ?? artifact.kind}
          </p>
        </div>

        {count > 1 && (
          <div className="flex items-center rounded-lg border text-xs" role="group" aria-label="Version">
            <IconBtn
              label="Previous version"
              disabled={version === 0}
              onClick={() => onVersionChange(version - 1)}
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
            </IconBtn>
            <span className="px-1 tabular-nums text-muted-foreground" aria-live="polite">
              v{version + 1}
              <span className="sr-only"> of {count}</span>
              <span aria-hidden>/{count}</span>
            </span>
            <IconBtn
              label="Next version"
              disabled={version === count - 1}
              onClick={() => onVersionChange(version + 1)}
            >
              <ChevronRight className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
            </IconBtn>
          </div>
        )}

        {hasSource && (
          <IconBtn label={copied ? "Copied" : "Copy"} onClick={copy} className="rounded-lg">
            {copied ? <Check className="size-3.5" aria-hidden /> : <Copy className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />}
          </IconBtn>
        )}
        <IconBtn label="Close panel" onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg">
          <X className="size-4" aria-hidden />
        </IconBtn>
      </header>

      {hasSource && (
        <div role="tablist" aria-label="View" className="flex gap-1 border-b px-3 py-1.5">
          {(["preview", "code"] as const).map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              id={`${id}-tab-${t}`}
              aria-selected={activeTab === t}
              aria-controls={`${id}-body`}
              onClick={() => setTab(t)}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground",
                activeTab === t && "bg-accent text-foreground"
              )}
            >
              {t === "preview" ? (
                <LayoutPanelLeft className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
              ) : (
                <Code2 className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
              )}
              {t === "preview" ? "Preview" : "Code"}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div
        id={`${id}-body`}
        role={hasSource ? "tabpanel" : undefined}
        aria-labelledby={hasSource ? `${id}-tab-${activeTab}` : undefined}
        aria-busy={generating || undefined}
        tabIndex={0}
        className="relative min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-auto outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-inset"
      >
        <AnimatePresence mode="wait" initial={false}>
          <motion.div
            key={`${current?.id}-${activeTab}`}
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: generating ? 0.45 : 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
          >
            {activeTab === "code" ? (
              <pre className="p-4 font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap text-muted-foreground">
                {current?.source}
              </pre>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-5">{current?.preview}</div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </AnimatePresence>
        {generating && (
          <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-0.5 overflow-hidden bg-muted">
            <motion.div
              className="h-full w-1/3 bg-foreground/40"
              animate={reduce ? undefined : { x: ["-100%", "300%"] }}
              transition={{ duration: 1.2, repeat: Infinity, ease: "easeInOut" }}
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </motion.aside>
  );
}

function IconBtn({
  label,
  onClick,
  disabled,
  className,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-label={label}
      title={label}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={cn(
        "flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40",
        className
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```
